# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.8 Worker 2: regional industries, employment systems and the Slot 89 pulse (oe_ind_ / oe_emp_ / oe_ind2_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v118_industry_employment.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 89 entry (called by the main-line scheduler or by the fallback pulse). Any country scope.
# Runs the market demand engine once a year on 6 fixed markets; no map or market scan.
oe_mfg_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_pulse_count add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { current_month = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1337
				current_year <= 1580
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_dem_cd_0 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_dem_cd_0 years = 15 }
			location:constantinople = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = {
							type = demand:oe_dem_royal_karkhaneh_silk
							years = 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1590
				current_year <= 1720
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_dem_cd_1 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_dem_cd_1 years = 15 }
			location:isfahan = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = {
							type = demand:oe_dem_royal_karkhaneh_silk
							years = 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1400
				current_year <= 1700
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_dem_cd_2 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_dem_cd_2 years = 15 }
			location:venice = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = {
							type = demand:oe_dem_arsenale_fleet_wave
							years = 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1600
				current_year <= 1780
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_dem_cd_3 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_dem_cd_3 years = 12 }
			location:fuliang = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = {
							type = demand:oe_dem_chinoiserie_boom
							years = 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1700
				current_year <= 1836
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_dem_cd_4 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_dem_cd_4 years = 12 }
			location:moscow = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = {
							type = demand:oe_dem_ural_iron_export
							years = 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1600
				current_year <= 1800
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind2_dem_cd_5 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind2_dem_cd_5 years = 12 }
			location:surat = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = market }
					market = {
						add_temporary_demand = {
							type = demand:oe_dem_indian_calico_craze
							years = 3
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope, players and great powers, once a quarter: triad synergy and at most one story event.
oe_ind2_country_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_ind2_has_triad = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ind2_triad_synergy_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev8_done } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev8_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.8
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev1_done }
			oe_ind2_has_any_promotion = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev2_done }
			has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_imperial_silk_corridor
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev6_done }
			current_year >= 1600
			has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_imperial_kiln_lacquer_belt
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev7_done }
			has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_indian_ocean_cotton_spices
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev9_done }
			current_year >= 1700
			oe_ind2_has_any_employment = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev9_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev10_cd }
			at_war = yes
			has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_gunpowder_ordnance_zone
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev10_cd years = 30 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.10
	}
	else = {
		oe_mfg_story_tick = yes
	}
}

# Dev page 84.
oe_ind2_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_ind2_adv_regional_charters } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_ind2_adv_regional_charters
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_ind2_adv_cameral_labor_allocation } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_ind2_adv_cameral_labor_allocation
	}
}

oe_ind2_dev_force_pulse = {
	oe_mfg_monthly = yes
	oe_ind2_country_tick = yes
}

oe_ind2_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.90
}
